title: SSMQI reliability study: preregistered analysis code
description: Frozen MATLAB analysis code, tests and documentation for a preregistered inter- and intra-rater reliability study of supraspinatus outlining and echo intensity on 2D shoulder ultrasound. No images, tracings or participant data are included. Preregistration: https://osf.io/gfd6t
